literal_meaning: চুরি (theft) এবং চামারি (leather work or lowly criminal acts, rhyming compound)
figurative_meaning_bn: একার্থক সহচরশব্দ; চুরি ও চুরির মতো অপকর্ম
figurative_meaning_en: Synonymous compound; theft and similar criminal acts
example_sentences_in_bangla: শহরে চুরিচামারির ঘটনা দৈনন্দিন হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Theft and robbery have increased a lot in the country.
Incidents of theft and criminal acts have become daily in the city.
note: A rhyming reduplicative expression common in colloquial Bengali for petty crimes.
